body.title: turn-lifecycle.ts: follow a saved turn
body.summary: Add follow(session, sink) and FollowSink to the module: move followLiveTurn's ownership and skip rules, the resume with the throttled cursor saves, nativeSessionId, the end-of-turn cursor clear and onEnd. Make stop also abort the follow and stop the resumed process, and make detach abort the follow without stopping that process. Add unit tests.
acceptanceChecks: follow is a no-op with no liveTurn, while already following the session, for a turn running in this host, and when the owner is another live host
follow takes ownership from a dead owner (ownerHostPid saved), passes every event to onEvent, clears the cursor and saves at the end, then calls onEnd
a resume that throws is logged and the cursor stays saved
stop aborts the follow and stops the resumed process; detach aborts the follow and leaves that process running
after detach of a session-file turn started here, follow resumes it

tests.name: follow skips a running turn, a turn already followed and a turn owned by a live host
follow takes ownership from a dead host, reports every event, clears the cursor and calls onEnd
a failing resume keeps the cursor saved
stop ends a followed turn's process; detach leaves it running
a detached session-file turn is resumed by follow
